items.title: Building trusted AI with data and AI governance partners on AWS
items.summary: The race to deploy agentic AI is outpacing the governance needed to put it into production - 74% of companies plan to deploy by 2027, yet only 21% have mature governance models. AWS launched GEAR (Governance Enabling Agentic Readiness) to close that gap, identifying partners whose governance accelerators compress months of setup into weeks and turn AI pilots into production-ready systems with measurable results.
items.creator: Jessica Enzi
